result.brief: 提出流形解耦的 JEPA 架构，将连续雷达物理状态预测与跨模态语言对齐分离，用 EMA-JEPA 与 VICReg 学习雷达表征并预测未来物理状态。
result.reason: Uses JEPA-style predictive latent learning and manifold-decoupled representation alignment, but applied to mmWave radar sensing with LLM adaptation rather than visual/video representation or world models.
